Tailspin Travel — Summer 2027 Campaign Brief

Prepared by the Tailspin Viajes marketing team (Buenos Aires and Santiago) for Acme Digital. Brief date: October 6, 2026. Campaign line: "Tu lugar en el mapa". This brief covers packages for travel between January and March 2027.

Objectives

  • Sell 4,800 summer packages, about USD 9.6 million in revenue.
  • Grow the share of bookings closed online or through WhatsApp from 35% to 45%.
  • Capture 25,000 new email leads for the 2027 winter season.

Destinations and starting prices

DestinationPackage from (per person)Share of media budget
Florianópolis, BrazilUSD 890 for Florianópolis30%
Punta Cana, Dominican RepublicUSD 1,650 for Punta Cana25%
Cancún, MexicoUSD 1,480 for Cancún20%
Salvador de Bahía, BrazilUSD 1,190 for Salvador15%
Punta del Este, UruguayUSD 720 for Punta del Este10%

Prices are per person in a double room, with flights from Buenos Aires or Santiago, 7 nights. Florianópolis gets the largest share of the media budget.

Budget and flight dates

  • Total media budget: USD 420,000 (USD 260,000 for Argentina and USD 160,000 for Chile).
  • Channel split: Meta 45%, Google (Search, Performance Max and YouTube) 40%, TikTok 15%.
  • Early-bird pre-sale: October 26 to November 30, 2026.
  • Main burst: December 1, 2026 to January 31, 2027.
  • Last-minute push: February 1 to February 28, 2027, focused on Punta del Este and Florianópolis.

Target audiences

  • Families with children, parents aged 30 to 50: Brazilian beaches and Punta del Este.
  • Couples aged 25 to 40 without children: Caribbean destinations.
  • Past travelers from the CRM: 52,000 consented emails, uploaded hashed.
  • Exclude anyone who booked a trip in the last 60 days.
  • Markets: Buenos Aires metro area, Córdoba and Rosario in Argentina; Santiago, Viña del Mar and Concepción in Chile.

KPIs

  • Cost per booking (CPA): USD 110 or less, blended across markets.
  • ROAS of at least 12 on media spend.
  • WhatsApp lead-to-booking rate of 9% or more.
  • Median first response time on WhatsApp under 10 minutes during business hours.

Creative mandatories

  • Every price says "from", the currency, and "per person, double occupancy".
  • Argentina: show the final price in pesos with all taxes included, next to the USD price. Chile: show prices in CLP and USD.
  • The Tailspin logo appears in the first 2 seconds of every video.
  • Sign-off: "Viajá con Tailspin" in Argentina and "Viaja con Tailspin" in Chile.
  • Never show airline or hotel brands; use our own photo bank or generic aircraft.
  • Legal line on every price ad: "Cupos limitados. Sujeto a disponibilidad. Ver condiciones de cancelación."
  • Final creatives are due to Tailspin for approval by October 20, 2026.
